reader_summary.headline: For this year's annual review.
reader_summary.overview: For this year's annual review, our CEO Hank and I cover investment trends across private and public markets and top-of-mind issues for allocators. We then discuss highlights of the podcast and our efforts to improve discoverability of great episodes, outstanding asset management fintech products, and Capital Allocators University. With the Year in Review, we also kick off our countdown of the most popular episodes of 2025.

key_points.text: We'll drop two this week and the top three next week.
Wishing you a relaxing, enjoyable, and very happy holiday!
